title: The Manor of Whispering Stone
dark_message: It's pitch black and you can't see a thing. You feel your way back before you trip over something.

win.message: The crown gleams in your hands. You have found the lost treasure of Whispering Stone. YOU WIN!

entrance_hall.name: Entrance Hall
entrance_hall.description: A grand entrance hall with a faded red carpet leading north. Cobwebs cling to the corners of the ceiling.

features.carpet: A once-luxurious red carpet, now moth-eaten and threadbare.

great_hall.name: Great Hall
great_hall.description: A vast hall with a suit of armor standing guard and a dust-covered chandelier overhead.

features.armor: A suit of plate armor, empty and silent, its visor rusted shut.
features.chandelier: A crystal chandelier, thick with dust, swinging gently though there is no wind.

library.name: Library
library.description: Dusty shelves of forgotten books line every wall. A rusty lever protrudes from the wall near the fireplace.

features.shelves: Rows of decaying books, their titles long faded.

secret_room.name: Secret Room
secret_room.description: A hidden room revealed by the lever. A single torch rests on a stone pedestal.

features.pedestal: A stone pedestal, carved with symbols you don't recognize.

cellar_stairs.name: Cellar Stairs
cellar_stairs.description: Rickety wooden stairs descend into darkness below.

features.stairs: Old wooden stairs, groaning under their own weight.

cellar.name: Cellar
cellar.description: A cold stone cellar. Your torchlight flickers over old barrels and crates.

features.barrels: Old wine barrels, long since empty.

vault.name: Vault
vault.description: A small stone vault. A golden crown rests on a velvet cushion.

features.cushion: A faded velvet cushion, once fit for royalty.

treasure_room.name: Treasure Room
treasure_room.description: A small chamber glittering faintly with old coins scattered across the floor.

features.coins: Scattered gold and silver coins, remnants of a forgotten hoard.

lever.name: Lever
lever.description: A rusty iron lever set into the wall.
lever.use_message: You pull the lever. Somewhere in the manor, stone grinds against stone.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: A wooden torch, its flame burning steady and bright.
torch.use_message: The torch burns brightly, casting light around you.

gold_crown.name: Gold Crown
gold_crown.description: An ornate golden crown, set with faded jewels.
